**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred position).**

No most-favoured-nation mechanic exists anywhere in the Transfer and Servicing Agreement in either direction. Multiple independent search passes across the MFN vocabulary (most favored nation, no less favorable, favorable terms to third parties, right to match, best price/discount, comparable transactions) returned nothing operative; the sole lexical near-hit (p0692) is a discount-rate convention referencing "pricing new issues of corporate debt securities of comparable maturity," not a terms-comparison obligation.

The covenant articles (Article IX Other Agreements; Article VI Servicer and Marketing Agent) bind the Depositor/Issuer only as to transfers, liens, expenses and servicing standards — nothing requires us to extend Cellco terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and there is no disclosure or matching mechanic. The preferred element ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is met by absence, so no redline was proposed.
